name: PLA (polylactic acid)
notes: The default FDM filament: stiff, dimensionally accurate, low warp, and forgiving of thin walls. Poor above roughly 50 C (a closed car interior will sag a part) and brittle under repeated impact, so avoid it for living hinges, clamps under sustained load, or anything near a motor. Print walls in multiples of the nozzle width (1.6 mm = 4 x 0.4 mm is a solid default minimum) and expect roughly 0.1-0.2 mm of oversizing on outer contours, so clearance fits need real clearance, not zero. Heat-set inserts seat well because the melt temperature is low.
